 introduction 
Do you have experience with spray-painting and do you want to work on the landing gear of top aircraft? Start working as an aircraft component painter in Papendrecht! At GKN Fokker, you combine true craftsmanship with a high-tech working environment. You earn an excellent salary up to € 25.85 gross per hour, receive a 26% shift allowance, and enjoy no less than 40 days off per year. 
 what we offer 
 A top starting salary up to € 25.85 gross per hour 
 An immediate shift allowance of 26% extra 
 Travel allowance for your commute 
 Career opportunities within aviation technology 
 No less than 27 vacation days and 13 ADV days 
 Working with modern manual spray equipment 
 who you are 
To keep the paint shop running smoothly, it is important that you as an aircraft component painter meet the following requirements: - You speak English or Dutch - You are available full-time for 40 hours per week - You are willing to work in shift schedules (06:00 - 14:36, 14:30 - 23:36, and 23:00 - 06:06) - You have demonstrable experience with spray painting - You can work with technical work instructions - You are willing to work in Papendrecht 
 what will you do 
As an aircraft component painter, you directly contribute to the safety of every aircraft. You start your workday by carefully studying the technical work instructions and procedures. Next, you prepare the landing gear components by thoroughly cleaning, sanding, and masking them. Using modern mixing installations and manual spray equipment, you apply the coatings and protective layers flawlessly. SamenvattingAre you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and wants to be part of an international logistics company? As a Warehouse Worker in Venlo, you and your colleagues ensure that everything in the warehouse runs smoothly. Good work!Over de functieYour responsibilities as a Warehouse Worker include:
- Collecting orders in the production or shipping department
- Scanning and repacking products
- Loading, unloading, and correctly placing goods with the help of a forklift
- Performing quality checks on shipped food supplements, including vitamins and minerals

You will work in a dayshift system from Monday to Friday, with the possibility to work extra shifts on Saturdays or Sundays during busy periods.
Working hours:
- 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM

Over het bedrijfGEODIS is a world leader in transport and logistics, specializing in road, air, and sea freight, as well as contract logistics. GEODIS operates in around 166 countries and employs more than 53,000 people worldwide. In 2023, the company achieved a turnover of more than €11.6 billion. In the warehouse, you will be part of a close-knit team where everyone supports each other and works together to get the job done. The atmosphere is dynamic, collegial, and focused on teamwork.
Wat wij vragen- Private accommodation
- Previous experience working with heftruck
- You are physically fit and enjoy being active
- Good command of the English language
- Flexibility to work on Saturdays or Sundays during peak periods

These points are important for working as a Warehouse Worker with heftruck experience in Venlo. But we are also curious about who you are. We would love to hear about your talents, background, and ideas. Surprise us.
Wat wij bieden- A base salary starting from €15,58 gross per hour
- Stable and long-term employment
- 25 vacation days and 8.33% holiday allowance
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per km (from 10.1 km up to a maximum of 35 km one way)
- Pension accrual from day 1
- A pleasant working environm

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Good work!Over de functieThe Operator A is responsible for ensuring that the assigned production line operates efficiently, producing products that meet both quality and quantity standards. This role involves performing basic production tasks while strictly adhering to safety and quality regulations.
Your key Responsibilities:
- Set up and monitor machines and automated processes
- Track production, manage orders, and make adjustments
- Perform quality checks, including metal detection, and report issues
- Maintain order and safety on the line
- Guide and supervise line staff to ensure compliance
- Escalate any deviations

Working hours:
- Our warehouses operate 24/7, so the work schedule includes weekend shifts as well as morning, afternoon, and night shifts.

Shift start times vary depending on the shift and the team. For example, a morning shift may start at 06:00, 08:00, or 10:00.

With a 33% market share in the Netherlands and partnerships with names like Jumbo and Superunie, we set the standard for freshness and innovation.
